question: What principle does the serpent king's elevation illustrate?
premises: Great and honored beings are naturally honored by all.
The serpent king was placed on the head of the Great Lord.
He was also borne by the gods.
inference: The story shows that those honored by the highest become worthy of universal honor.
plain_english: For the great and honored, universal reverence is no wonder; therefore the serpent king came to rest on the head of the Great Lord and, in every way, on the gods as well.
